source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In Finnish registry data there was no difference in MPNST survival between patients with and without NF1.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 14 Uusitalo 2016 PMID 26926675. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading. Finnish registry analysis (ref 14, n=1,404 clinically diagnosed NF1, 19,076 person-years). This conflicts with the meta-analysis claim in the same guideline (see the Kolberg 2013 claim); both are recorded.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 14
